name: io.github.theoddden/terradev
title: Terradev
description: Cross-cloud GPU orchestration CLI. Set provider API keys as environment variables (RUNPOD_API_KEY, LAMBDA_API_KEY, etc). 261 MCP tools covering provisioning, inference, training, and observability across 17 verified providers.

environmentVariables.name: RUNPOD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: RunPod API key — get at runpod.io/console/settings/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: VAST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Vast.ai API key — get at console.vast.ai/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: LAMBDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Lambda Labs API key — get at cloud.lambdalabs.com/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: HF_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HuggingFace API token — get at huggingface.co/settings/tokens

environmentVariables.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: AWS access key ID (pair with AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to GCP service account JSON key file

environmentVariables.name: TERRADEV_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for SSE/remote transport mode (stdio mode does not require this)
